channel.title: geekmomprojects
channel.description: I make techie projects with (and sometimes without) my kids.  Visit my blog at http://www.geekmomprojects.com

videos.t: Light Up Sweatshirt Using Arduino Lilypad
videos.desc: Instructions at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/a-programmable-led-sweatshirt/ This video shows a sweatshirt with our team logo (a fire-breathing chicken) enhanced by LEDs programmed and driven with an Arduino LilyPad micro controller.

videos.t: Arduino LilyPad Simple Board LED Panel
videos.desc: This video demonstrates a programmable light-up LED panel I sewed to go inside a sweatshirt using an Arudino Lilypad Simple Board and Arduino LEDs.  Details of the project can be found on my blog at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/a-programmable-led-sweatshirt/.
Programmable 6x6x6 LED Cube run by an Arduino Uno

Instructions at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/led-matrix-shirt/ Demonstration of a T-shirt with a removable fabric panel that contains an 8x6 matrix of LilyPad LEDs controlled by an Arduino LilyPad controller.  It plays four different games controlled by a small joystick.  For more information on this project, visit my blog at www.geekmomprojects.com

videos.t: MPU-6050 Data with a Complementary Filter
videos.desc: Writeup of this project at:  http://www.geekmomprojects.com/gyroscopes-and-accelerometers-on-a-chip/.  Real-time Accelerometer and Gyroscope data from a MPU-6050 IMU is displayed independently as well as combined with a complementary filter.  Other articles can be found at my blog:  http://www.geekmomprojects.com
Instructions at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/wii-nunchuck-controlled-servo-motors/.  Demonstrates using a Wii Nunchuck to control two servo motors.

videos.t: i2cdevlib "Teapot" Demo with an MPU-6050 IMU
videos.desc: Writeup of this demo available at:  http://www.geekmomprojects.com/mpu-6050-dmp-data-from-i2cdevlib/.  Demonstration of the "Teapot" Demo from i2cdevlib, written by Jeff Rowberg, on an MPU-6050 6DOF IMU.

videos.t: A Soft Circuit Potentiometer Makes Music
videos.desc: See project write-up at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/a-soft-circuit-potentiometer-makes-music.  Conductive ribbon and a metal ring make a soft-circuit potentiometer, which control the tones played by an Arduino LilyPad buzzer.
Use conductive and resistive dough, a battery and an RGB LED to mix different colors of light.  See a write up at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/squishy-circuits-color-mixing-with-light/.

videos.t: The "Halfway" - testing a DIY Segway Clone
videos.desc: Test drive of the self-balancing scooter.  Writeup coming soon.
Riding the "Halfway", a self-balancing, arduino controlled scooter.  Writeup available at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/the-halfway-a-self-balancing-scooter/

videos.t: MPU-6050 Orientation from DMP vs. Complementary Filter
videos.desc: Writeup with code at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/mpu-6050-redux-dmp-data-fusion-vs-complementary-filter/.  Compares the computed orientation of a 6DOF IMU (the MPU-6050) from the complementary filter algorithm to the orientation computed by the MPU-6050 DMP.

Following instructions from Joo and CrazyChicken563 on Thingiverse we combined laser-cut and 3d-printed parts with electronics to build a clock that writes the time in erasible pen, then erases iteslf before starting over again.  Instructions and build files at http://www.thingiverse.com/thing:248009 and http://www.thingiverse.com/thing:346784.  Writeup of my build can be found at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/building-plotclock/

PlotClock final incarnation.  Uses RTC module DS3231 to keep time.  Arduino Nano clone powered by 9V battery and 3 servos powered by 4 AA batteries.  Instructions and build files at http://www.thingiverse.com/thing:248009 and http://www.thingiverse.com/thing:346784.  Writeup of my build can be found at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/building-plotclock/
Wall plotter, based on the Der Kritzler model, makes a crosshatch-style drawing of the Mona Lisa.
We made the Tiny CNC v0.29 published by Maker Block on Thingiverse (http://www.thingiverse.com/thing:200895), and turned it into an Etch-a-Sketch
We built the Mini CNC v0.29 by MakerBlock from http://www.thingiverse.com/thing:200895 and programmed an Arduino to make it draw spirograph patterns.  Two 10K pots control the spirograph parameters.

Demo of the MeArm built from the open-source files by Pheoptix at Thingiverse:  http://www.thingiverse.com/thing:360108.  I built a small custom controller with an Arduino and linear and twist potentiometers  to control the four 9g servo motors which make it move.  Write-up of the build at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/making-mearm/
An easel-mounted wall-plotter run by a Raspberry Pi and Arduino.  Writeup at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/yawp-yet-another-wall-plotter/
Just got the TinyScreen and TinyDuino from TinyCircuits and programmed then to display the Mandelbrot set.
3D printed casing turns the TinyScreen into a necklace.  3D print files are at http://www.thingiverse.com/thing:739648.
Added buttons to a new 3D printed version of the TinyScreen necklace case.  Also wrote a program to respond to the button presses by changing the display of a rotating wire-frame shape.

An implementation of Conway's Game of Life on a 32x32 pixel SmartMatrix board, using a Teensy 3.1 with a SmartMatrix shield and a custom controller.  Project write up is at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/life-on-a-smartmatrix-board/

Used a Node.js server to interface an Arduino circuit with a web client.  Based on a project by Gianluca Guarini (https://youtu.be/_Wo5UExJ_Lk). I modified his project slightly to add a potentiometer and web slider. Modified code found here (https://github.com/geekmomprojects/NodeJSArduinoExample)
Simple cirucuit lights up when it gets dark.  Perfect for Halloween.  Instructions at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/halloween-photoresistor-circuit/
Demonstration of controlling the EtchABot, an Arduino controlled CNC Etch A Sketch with a thumb joystick.  Writeup at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/etchabot-a-cnc-etch-a-sketch/

The EtchABot, an Arduino controlled CNC Etch A Sketch, demonstrating analog clock mode.  It's not the most dynamic video, but remember, you're watching an analog clock tell time.  Write up of EtchABot at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/etchabot-a-cnc-etch-a-sketch/.

The music, Rubix Cube by Audionautix, is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution license (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
Artist: http://audionautix.com/

Highly repetitive but soothing video of EtchABot, an Arduino controlled CNC Etch A Sketch, drawing Spirograph patterns and erasing them over and over.  Writeup of EtchABot at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/etchabot-a-cnc-etch-a-sketch/
Snowflake drawn from vector image file using EtchABot.
Demonstration of a Twitter-connected LED Matrix handbag wearables project.  Project writeup at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/tweet-my-purse/

videos.t: LED Matrix Bag v 2.0 Quick Demo
videos.desc: Quick look at version 2.0 of the LED Matrix Handbag.  Writeup coming soon to www.geekmomprojects.com.  Sorry for the vertical video!

An updated version of my IOT-connected LED matrix handbag using a removable flexible LED panel.  Project writeup at http://www.geekmomprojects.com/led-matrix-handbag-2-0-how-to. Also a more complete documentation from start to finish is online at http://makezine.com/projects/led-matrix-handbag/

videos.t: Fiber Optic LED Dress with Adafruit Circuit Playground Controller
videos.desc: Fiber Optic LED Dress controlled by Adafruit Circuit Playground

videos.t: Fiber Optic LED Dress Controlled by Adafruit Circuit Playground
videos.desc: Demonstration of my fiber-optic LED dress with a Circuit Playground controller. The video has already circulated on Twitter, just thought I should add it it to my YouTube Channel.

Hey Los Angeles folks, I'm running a fundraising workshop for @PSScience123 to construct, decorate and code your own programmable LED headbands. It's a unique class and supports science education for kids in underserved communities. Link to sign up here: https://psscience.org/2018/02/06/ps-science-presents-a-fundraising-workshop-headband-glam/

LEDs sewn into a jacket controlled by an Adafruit Trinket M0, which is connected to a Raspberry Pi Zero W running a hotspot. The Raspberry Pi runs an Apache web server serving a program I wrote called "Brightly" (also at www.geekmomprojects.com/brightly) that generates CircuitPython code to program the LEDs. If you're at Bay Area Maker Faire 2018 - come by my booth (Bright Wearables) and try it out.

This tutorial shows how to make a bright and colorful programmable LED baseball cap - no sewing required (some soldering is necessary) This is my first video tutorial but you can find other projects on my blog: www.geekmomprojects.com
Demonstration of an edge-lit LED acrylic flower project. Details on my blog at: http://www.geekmomprojects.com/edge-lit-acrylic-led-flower/
Acrylic heart with embedded LED strips produces an animated “inner glow” for Valentines Day
Trying out different etching patterns in the "Inner Glow" LED acrylic heart. Write up of this project is in progress.

Stop motion video of constructing an edge-lit pendant. This is a simple project and great for kids. A post containing a more detailed write-up on this project will be up on my blog, www.geekmomprojects.com shortly.
Edge-lit acrylic and skinny SK6812 LED strips are combined to make seven segment displays arranged in clock form. Write up of this project on my blog: www.geekmomprojects.com

Unveiled this dress at my talk at Maker Faire Bay Area 2019. Made with an off-the-rack dress enhanced with 5 strips of SK6812 3535 LEDs diffused through a thin layer of muslin and covered by laser cut strips of faux vinyl. Controlled by Adafruit’s Feather NRF52840 board, connected to their Bluefruit app on an iPad.

videos.t: Etched Teeny Tiny Edge Lit Display Project
videos.desc: Making the kid-friendliest version of the Teeny-Tiny Edge-Lit Display. Kids can etch their own designs into the acrylic with a small file. Write-up coming soon to my blog, www.geekmomprojects.com

videos.t: Bright Bag Display for Rose Parade Craft Fair
videos.desc: Testing out an idea for displaying the Bright Bags at the Rose Parade Craft Fair

videos.t: LED Little Black Dress with Sound Reactive Mode and Other Patterns
videos.desc: This video displays the different LED modes on my latest Little Black Dress project. The controller is an Adafruit Circuit Playground Bluefruit and the LEDs are from a standard WS2812 LED strip cut into 5 segments and connected by wires in the hem.
Edge-lit pendants created with layers of laser-cut wood and semi-translucent acrylic. Project write-up at https://www.geekmomprojects.com/layered-edge-lit-pendants
Directions to assemble and wear the micro:bit carrying case for PS Science Summer Camp 2020
Directions to assemble Fairy Light Belt project for PS Science
Edge-lit acrylic illuminated by a double-sided side-emitting LED strip makes a fun and unusual hanukiyah for the holidays.
Video of my recent illuminated fiber-optic hyperbolic paraboloid project. Build instructions documented on my blog at: https://www.geekmomprojects.com/fiber-optic-hyperbolic-paraboloid/

Video demonstration of a project build for Adafruit Learn Guides. An infinity mirror build from flexible holographic vinyl makes for a creative wearable. Learn how to build your own infinity mirror collar at https://learn.adafruit.com/infinity-mirror-collar
Frameless infinity mirror octahedron using laser cut two-way mirrored acrylic and 144 LEDs/m WS2812b LED strip cut and soldered around the shape's 12 edges.
Demo of an edge-lit flower design constructed by embedding an LED strip inside an acrylic layer cut into individually illuminated pieces.
Description of how I constructed an articulated PCB assembly
Demo of 3D print files for an LED modular ring using a CR1225 battery. Print files available at https://www.prusaprinters.org/prints/136889-illuminated-bling-ring

A set of RGB LED enhanced pillows created by sewing a flexible LED string (5cm LED spacing) in a  to a decorative (20"x20") pillow insert, covering with a layer of batting and inserting into a white velveteen cover. The set of pillows in this video are controlled by a PixelBlaze controller.
